This scene:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃：delete很，delete也
- 吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况：delete你的，redundant; 是很麻烦的情况
- 但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 很不知道：不知道，The degree adverb 很 cannot directly modify the negative mental-state verb 知道 in this construction. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 也什么植物不能吃：什么植物不能吃，After 不知道, this should be a parallel object clause; 也 cannot directly precede a noun phrase or clause and must be followed by a verb phrase. [teacher rule: ye_vp]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] ，很麻烦的情况：，这是一种很麻烦的情况，The original ending is only a noun phrase and cannot serve as a complete predicate; add 这 and 是 to form a complete statement. [rule: none]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 你的身体：他们的身体，The second-person pronoun does not refer back to the group of many people; use a pronoun that clearly refers to them. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题：但是有一个叫神农的人要解决这个问题，On first mention, introduce the character clearly with both his name and a full noun phrase describing who he is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
